text:
maya: Short thread (8m). We need a deployable "contract playbook" for routing + multi-region tenant isolation for pilot customers. Sales wants clear buyer language + launch gates.

dante: From eng: split the scope into three deliverables — routing policy templates, pilot_acceptance_harness, and an ops eviction choreography. Each needs a concrete test.

asha: Product POV: sales needs a 2-line promise and a simple checklist. Also they asked for an example contract bullet that mentions remedies and required onboarding steps.

ron: Ops: we're fine shipping templates first. Call them: `reserved-slice`, `shared-guarded`, `preemptible-evict`. We'll need automation labels and an API hook to apply templates.

lia: Legal: any SLA numbers will trigger remedy discussions. Provide acceptance-test names and precise pass conditions so legal can write the clause.

maya: Draft buyer blurb: "Regional latency envelope and optional isolation tiers — pilot customers can opt into reserved slices and verified isolation tests before contract." feedback?

dante: OK. For tests I propose: 
- pilot_acceptance_harness_v1: run 10k cross-tenant probes across KV & prefix cache; zero namespace collisions observed.
- regional_load_verifier: synthetic load across target regions validating P95/P99 under declared band at 60% sustained load.
- eviction_choreography_test: preempt sequence -> graceful drain -> cold-evict; final RTO measured for queued requests.

asha: Can we make numbers tier-aware? e.g., Gold (reserved) RTO target 45s, Silver (guarded) 90s, Bronze best-effort. Sales likes tiered figures.

ron: That works operationally if Gold customers accept reserved warm slices. We'll require an onboarding window to warm caches. Add requirement: committed throughput or Dedicated reservation.

lia: Legal note: include a clause template that says "SLA applies only after pilot_acceptance_harness_v1 and eviction_choreography_test are completed and signed off in writing." I can draft language once tests are finalized.

maya: Action items: 
- eng (dante): document test names + short run commands + ETA (due Tue)
- ops (ron): publish template names, automation labels, and eviction playbook stub (due Wed)
- product (asha + maya): write the sales 1-pager + sample SLA bullet (due Fri)
- legal (lia): standby to convert acceptance tests into contract clause once eng posts details
- release-bot: open tracking ticket when eng posts tests

release-bot: Created ticket PROD-5560: "Contract playbook + pilot acceptance harness" assigned to dante.

dante: I'll push a minimal `pilot_acceptance_harness_v1` script to infra that emits a pass/fail artifact and a short readme with the 10k probe command.

asha: I'll draft the one-pager with an "eligibility checklist" section: committed throughput OR Dedicated reservation, signed onboarding window, and acceptance test sign-off.

ron: Ops will map runtime knobs to templates (batching caps, cache policy, quant profile, eviction thresholds) and put a short table in the playbook.

maya: We'll review the one-pager in Monday's roadmap sync and try to freeze the gate list. Keep followups short here. :sparkles:
